scope: A starting point for future I Am Free to Dream recordings. Language and arrangement overrides preserve local musical choices; historical actual settings remain unchanged.

defaults.vocal_gender: Unselected; voice directed in the language prompt
defaults.exclude_styles: EDM, heavy dance beats, aggressive percussion, theatrical belting, excessive vocal runs, vocoder, chopped vocals

exception_rule: Inherit baseline, then adopted language overrides, then adopted language/arrangement overrides. Document changed controls, musical reason, decision reference and review status. Proposed comparisons do not apply automatically. Per-run author directions take precedence and must be recorded. This policy does not authorize generation credits.
